contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The clearest measured convergence sits in semiconductors, where MU combines insider, congressional and patent activity, while INTC adds grants and analyst sentiment; PLTR has broader but more sentiment-heavy alignment. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains modest and weaker clusters are omitted.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: The pack's strongest weighted cluster joins net congressional buying by three members [congress_cluster], strongly positive insider purchase pressure [insider_mspr], 369 patents [patent_cluster] and uniformly bullish Stocktwits sentiment [stocktwits_bull]. The channels span informed transactions, technical activity and retail positioning, while relative strength is only +7.6 percentage points and the name is not extended.
second_order: Memory-equipment suppliers — stronger memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand.
Data-center memory supply chain — improving memory demand would benefit advanced packaging and component vendors.
Semiconductor materials — higher memory utilization would increase consumables demand.

falsifier.text: Insider purchase pressure reverses while congressional net activity turns negative and patent momentum fails to translate into improving operating demand.

Drug-manufacturing partners — successful label expansion could require additional production capacity.
Oncology care infrastructure — broader treatment use would increase diagnostics and care-coordination needs.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
